hero.title: Grow your waterway tour business
hero.description: Bring your boats, tours, schedules, and guest bookings into one operating flow built for Da Nang waterway tourism.

benefits.title: Run daily operations from one place
benefits.subtitle: DDMS gives boat owners a focused workspace for tour listings, departure schedules, and customer demand.

manageTours.title: Manage tours
manageTours.description: Create tour listings, update pricing, organize photos, and keep public information ready for booking.

scheduleBoats.title: Schedule boats
scheduleBoats.description: Attach boats to upcoming departures, track availability, and avoid overlapping operating slots.

receiveBookings.title: Receive bookings
receiveBookings.description: View guest reservations, booking status, guest counts, add-ons, and trip notes in one queue.

process.title: A clear path to publish your first tour
process.subtitle: The owner flow is designed around verification first, then reliable tour operations.

profile.title: Create your owner profile
profile.description: Add your business name, operating address, and contact information for guest support.

verify.title: Verify your license
verify.description: Submit license details so the platform can review your eligibility before opening bookings.

publish.title: Publish tours
publish.description: Add boats, create tours, set departure schedules, and start receiving reservations.

boatInfo.description: Have boat names, types, passenger capacity, images, cabins, and onboard services ready.

contact.description: Provide a business phone number and support address for booking coordination.

hero.title: Discover Da Nang's Waterway Beauty
hero.description: Book river cruises on the Han River, watch the Dragon Bridge breathe fire, and enjoy an unforgettable waterway journey.

tours.title: Featured Tours
tours.subtitle: The most loved waterway experiences in Da Nang

howItWorks.title: Book in 4 Easy Steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, fast, and reliable
howItWorks.step1Desc: Explore waterway tours by location, price, or departure date.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Pick a date, time, and number of passengers that suits you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Arrive at the dock and begin your amazing river journey.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Share your experience to help other travelers.

promo.fireworksDesc: Enjoy the spectacular international fireworks display and glowing Han river lights from the premium deck of our luxury cruise ship.
promo.sunsetDesc: Organize private events, sunset dinners, or peaceful sea cruises along the Hai Van pass on our premium catamaran.

providers.yachtDesc: Book custom itinerary cruises with verified captains.

mar.label: March (Spring)
mar.title: Spring Han River Excursion
mar.desc: Enjoy clear skies and gentle morning sun on a peaceful cruise along the scenic Han River.

jun.label: June (Summer)
jun.title: DIFF Fireworks Festival Night
jun.desc: Admire international fireworks displays lighting up the night sky right from the deck.

sep.label: September (Autumn)
sep.title: Da Nang Bay Sunset Voyage
sep.desc: Sail off into the poetic golden and purple sunset as the evening breeze cools the bay.

dec.label: December (Winter)
dec.title: Han River Winter Light Cruise
dec.desc: Watch the city lights shimmer on the moving winter waters in a warm cozy onboard atmosphere.

cta.title: Ready for a River Adventure?
cta.description: Sign up today and get a special offer on your first tour booking.
